title: Waymo Named Las Vegas Raiders' Ride Partner
summary: Waymo announced on August 13, 2026 that it is the Official Autonomous Ride-Hailing Partner of the Las Vegas Raiders and Allegiant Stadium, the first partnership between a professional football team and an autonomous vehicle company. Starting this season, riders traveling to Raiders games, concerts, and other stadium events will have access to a dedicated Waymo pickup and drop-off zone with dedicated wayfinding signage. The deal includes a VIP fan upgrade at every home game and a "Kickoff Kid" program for local youth. It builds on Waymo's existing robotaxi service, which as of August 2026 runs roughly 4,000 driverless vehicles across 15 U.S. cities.
whyItMatters: Stadium and event-venue partnerships put a robotaxi service in front of tens of thousands of riders on a predictable schedule at low cost, and a professional sports league lending its brand to a driverless car company is itself a marker of how mainstream robotaxis have become -- particularly in Las Vegas, where Waymo already competes with Zoox for market share. For Waymo, it also hedges against the event-night surge demand that has historically been hard for ride-hailing services to handle well.
